title: Mini project: Voice → Structured Notes + PairCraft beta
objective: Ship your first end-to-end LLM feature with audio: transcript → schema-validated extraction with confidence → review queue → export, with retries and cost logging. Load-test PairCraft and ship the beta.
topics: Review-queue UX; feedback logged as eval data
PairCraft: k6 load test, bottleneck fixes, README, architecture diagram, demo video
theory: Ed Donner Week 3 meeting-minutes project as the base.
deliverables: PairCraft beta: public URL, README → diagram → API spec → tests → CI → deploy → metrics → k6 benchmark → demo video
checkpoint: Process a 60-s clip end to end
PairCraft handles 200 concurrent editors within p95 targets (or you know why not)

knowledge: Why per-field confidence and a review queue?
What is your cost per record and its biggest driver?
Which PairCraft component saturated first under load?
practical: Number of Islands + Clone Graph cold
Show the k6 table in the PairCraft README
